items.title: Crook poses as collector, civic chief to dupe officials
items.desc: Nagpur Cyber Police file FIR after fraudster impersonates district collector and municipal commissioner on WhatsApp to dupe officials; probe underway.

items.title: Teen girl hacked to death by brother over relationship in Sitapur
items.desc: Sitapur, UP: 17-year-old girl allegedly hacked to death by elder brother over love affair; accused absconding as police form teams and investigate.

items.title: Rly employee dies by suicide during video call with girlfriend
items.desc: Lucknow: 26-year-old railway employee Rohit Prajapati found hanging during a video call with girlfriend in Alambagh; police investigating, no note found.

items.title: Ahead of tourist season, Goa declares war on negative reviews in the comments section
items.desc: Goa tourism department plans a “Centre for Online Reputation Management” war room to monitor and respond to negative social media, reviews and misinformation.

items.title: Probe links Bhilwara maternal deaths to separate complications
items.desc: Probe into two Bhilwara postpartum deaths found separate complications: amniotic fluid embolism with DIC and severe anaemia causing hypovolaemic shock; action ordered.

items.title: Love affair angle in Hardoi double murder case, 5 held
items.desc: Hardoi double murder case solved: Police arrest 2 adults and detain 3 juveniles over alleged love affair motive; Jal Jeevan Mission workers killed in Sandila.

items.title: Raj’s drug haul tops Rs 700cr in 10 months, 84 suspects held
items.desc: Rajasthan ANTF seized narcotics worth Rs 700 crore in 10 months, including 360 kg opium and 185 kg MD; 34 MD units busted and 84 suspects arrested.

items.title: Margao teen dies as car hits barrier, catches fire
items.desc: Goa: 19-year-old Margao resident Yash Mehta died after a car hit a barrier on NH66 near Sainik Aaramghar, caught fire; police say driver was rash.

items.title: Jail computer theft cracked in 3 hours, accused held with stolen equipment in Bahraich
items.desc: Bahraich police solved a district jail computer theft in 3 hours, arresting Sahil Qadri and recovering a dismantled all-in-one PC, keyboard and tools.

items.title: Ahmedabad, Gujarat out of ‘red’; rain to ease from Monday
items.desc: IMD lifts red alert for Ahmedabad; Gujarat to see isolated heavy rain in north on Sunday, then mostly light to moderate showers from Monday onward.

items.title: Nearly 10% pregnant women found anaemic in Dungarpur: Centre to LS
items.desc: Lok Sabha data: 3,152 of 34,304 pregnant women in Dungarpur were severely anaemic in 11 months; 1,662 blood units transfused; Centre cites existing schemes.

items.title: ATS court awards 10-year jail term to CPI (Maoist) operative in arms haul case
items.desc: Special ATS court in Lucknow sentences CPI (Maoist) operative Sunil Ravidas to 10 years in jail and Rs 20,000 fine in 2016 arms haul case.

items.title: 5 officials suspended, FIR against 77 after Ambedkar statue row sparks violence in Deoria
items.desc: Deoria violence over removal of unauthorized Ambedkar statue: 5 officials suspended, village head served notice, FIR filed against 77 for rioting and attack.

items.title: Gaza Health Ministry says July deadliest month of Israeli strikes in 2026
items.desc: Palestinian officials said 152 people were killed in Israeli attacks last month, while the military said it struck Hamas weapons storage sites. A doctor at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital said a strike destroyed supplies used to treat dialysis patients and wounded p…

items.title: JMC adopts Class 12 student’s posters for city sanitation campaigns
items.desc: Jaipur Municipal Corporation adopts three IEC posters designed by Class 12 student Saarakshi Singh for city sanitation, cleanliness and waste management campaigns.

items.title: BLW sets record with production of 65 electric locomotives in July
items.desc: Banaras Locomotive Works set a record in July 2026, producing 65 electric locomotives—44 WAG-9HC, 13 WAP-7 and 8 Amrit Bharat—for Indian Railways.

items.title: Date packaging unit in Dubagga damaged in major fire; six tenders deployed
items.desc: Massive basement fire at Lucknow’s Dubagga date packaging factory; six fire tenders controlled blaze in 90 minutes. No casualties; short circuit suspected.

items.title: LDA JE, supervisor held for accepting ₹7.5 lakh bribe
items.desc: LDA junior engineer, supervisor and middleman arrested in Lucknow after UP Vigilance trap caught them taking ₹7.5 lakh bribe; case filed under PCA.

items.title: Cyber Police arrest Nagpur man in Rs 23L IPO scam
items.desc: Rajasthan Cyber Police arrested Nagpur man Nirmal Verma for allegedly aiding a Rs 23 lakh IPO investment scam via fake WhatsApp groups and portals.

items.title: Conference highlights personalised approach to heart valve treatment
items.desc: SGPGIMS Lucknow meet spotlights minimally invasive valve therapies like TAVI and mitral surgery, weighing catheter vs open-heart options and training surgeons in complex procedures.
